meta.purpose: Rules for deciding which discovered event candidates can be auto-published and which require human review.
meta.principle: AI extraction + an independent AI verifier pass is the trust mechanism, not source type. Objective fact checks (missing fields, past dates, duplicates) are a hard floor no confidence score can override. Anything that doesn't clear both goes to a GitHub Issue for human review, not a silently-updated PR.

aiVerification.notes: Auto-publish requires: passes hardFloor AND verify.mjs's independent confidence >= autoPublishConfidenceThreshold. Source type is no longer a gate by default -- see sourceOverrides for exceptions learned over time.

sourceOverrides.notes: Source ids listed here always route to human review regardless of verifier confidence -- an escape hatch for sources that have proven unreliable, without having to touch decide.mjs.

legacy.note: The fields below described the pre-AI heuristic pipeline's source-type gating. No longer read by decide.mjs; kept for reference only.
